audit.identityPolicy: The source player URL is the source key; only exact reviewed identity links may collapse records. Historical players remain in the ranking evidence and outside the modern playable default unless explicitly curated.
audit.ties: Competition ranking by exact raw value; equal values share rank and tie_group; subsequent ranks include skipped positions. The 200 source rows are retained even when rank exceeds 200 because the source cutoff is row-based.
